$comment: Committed and shared with everyone who clones this repo, so it holds only project-scoped rules. Personal preferences (marketplaces, plugins, default permission mode, proxies) belong in ~/.claude/settings.json; machine-local overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.

permissions.$comment: Enumerated rather than .env.*, because deny beats allow: that glob would also block .env.example, which is committed and has to stay readable. Add any new .env.<name> here — an unlisted one is readable.
